audit.why: 42.11% over 57 games at Emerald+ matches the shape: Akshan owns levels 1-2 on Avengerang's 850 range against an Akali who only has Five Point Strike (550), loses tempo at 3 once Shuriken Flip (16s) and Twilight Shroud (20s) land, and is behind from her first AP item. Difficulty 7/10 is right.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every FULL-layer phase why was generic boilerplate that named no Akali ability and described Akshan winning stages the chart hands to Akali.
audit.why: The real spikes are Akali's level 3 (Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 plus Twilight Shroud 20/19/18/17/16), her 6 (Perfect Execution 120/90/60, 675 range, execute), and her first AP item. Akshan's are level 2 and Comeuppance at 6.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[1..3], [5] and [6] around those cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The FULL layer never stated the decisive interaction — Twilight Shroud makes Akali unselectable, which drops Comeuppance's lock and Heroic Swing's auto-fire target — and referred to Akali as 'he' throughout.
audit.why: Riot's Twilight Shroud text: while inside, she is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'. Comeuppance 'locks onto an enemy champion' and Heroic Swing 'repeatedly fir[es] at the nearest enemy' — both are selection-based, so both blank. Heroic Swing also 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions', so she can body-block the arc. Assassin's Mark (P) is an auto-attack reset, so the ring exit — not the ability cast — is the tell.
audit.corrected: Twilight Shroud (20s) makes her unselectable: your Comeuppance lock and Heroic Swing's auto-target both drop. Fight the exit, and never swing into her — colliding with a champion ends the arc.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere in the FULL layer.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud 20/19/18/17/16, Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Perfect Execution 120/90/60 are the three punishable windows; Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 is what you bank against them.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull, dontsFull and report.

audit.whatIsWrong: Common-mistake headings used male pronouns for Akali.
audit.why: Voice defect, not a mechanical one, but it reads as generated text on a live page.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in dontsFull titles and tradeGood.

edits.before: Q max gets the return hit — both boomerang passes on him plus the passive proc is a third of his HP bar.
edits.after: Both Avengerang passes plus the third-hit proc chip a melee Akali who must walk into your autos to farm.

edits.before: Full kit: E swing around terrain fires while moving — trades start at angles melee kits literally cannot answer.
edits.after: She gets Shuriken Flip (E, 16s) and Twilight Shroud (20s) — the free-poke window shuts and she dodges the double-shot.

edits.before: Trade on his CS timings and bank the passive shield-sprints. Track Twilight Shroud; the swing dies to one good answer.
edits.after: Bank Heroic Swing (18s) for her Shuriken Flip, not for poke — Twilight Shroud blanks anything you commit into the smoke.

edits.before: First item spike — the swing-fire pattern now removes half bars. Take over the lane and start roaming for revives.
edits.after: Her first AP item makes the shroud combo lethal before your lethality matters — farm, roam, and stop taking duels.

edits.before: Crit items even out the field — your edge stays the map game: revives, executes, and swings nobody wards.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud drops your R lock-on and E's auto-target — she picks you on any facecheck. Win before this.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E swing has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Akali Twilight Shroud: 20/19/18/17/16s — she is unselectable inside, so your R lock-on and E's auto-target both drop. Fight when it ends. - Shuriken Flip is 16s at rank 1: that is the window Heroic Swing is saved for. - R only on a shroudless Akali.

edits.before: Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1 — she cannot be selected inside it, so commit only once it expires.

edits.before: Akali spends Twilight Shroud early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Comeuppance locks onto a champion — a shrouded Akali cannot be locked, so bait the smoke first.

edits.before: Trade flat at his preferred range
edits.after: Trade flat at her preferred range

edits.before: That is Akali’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Five Point Strike slows on a 1.5s cooldown — she wins flat.

edits.before: The swing has one interrupt answer — using E as an entrance instead of an exit hands him that answer for free.
edits.after: Heroic Swing ends the moment it collides with a champion — she steps into the arc and you land in her lap.

edits.before: Channel R while his interrupt is up
edits.after: Channel R while her shroud is up

edits.before: Swinging INTO a loaded kit for style points — one interrupt mid-arc and you're a stationary marksman in melee range.
edits.after: Comeuppance needs a lock and she shrouds mid-channel — then Perfect Execution (120/90/60) answers from 675 range.

edits.before: Track Akali’s Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud (20s) makes her unselectable — your Comeuppance lock and Heroic Swing's auto-target both drop. Fight the exit.

edits.before: Commit on Twilight Shroud’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Bait the answer, then sign.
edits.after: Commit inside Twilight Shroud's 20s downtime and before her first AP item; after 6, Perfect Execution (120s) closes on you.
